steps.say: We measure short lengths in centimetres, written cm.

figure.alt: A pencil next to a ruler. It starts at 0 and ends at 7 cm.

steps.say: Line up one end with 0. Read the number at the other end.
Longer lengths are measured in metres, written m.
To change metres to centimetres, multiply by 100.
2 m 45 cm is 200 cm and 45 cm more.

hints: Check that the crayon starts at 0.
Look at where the other end of the crayon is.
Read the number under that end.
check.explanation: The crayon starts at 0 and ends at 9, so it is 9 cm long.

figure.alt: A crayon next to a ruler. It starts at 0 and ends at 9 cm.
